question: Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept below B. Only two boxes are kept between B and G. Only A is kept immediately above E. F is kept in some place below D and in some place above C. How many boxes are kept below C?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.
